tagline.en: eSIM marketplace reselling multiple brands at wholesale-style prices
tagline.zh: 聚合多品牌的 eSIM 市场，批发式低价转售

description.en: MobiMatter is a marketplace rather than a carrier: it resells eSIM plans from multiple suppliers (Sparks, NextLink, IIJ, TSimTech, even Airalo packs) across 200+ countries, often below the brands' own prices. Payment and support run through MobiMatter, not the underlying brand.
description.zh: MobiMatter 是市场聚合商而非运营商：转售 Sparks、NextLink、IIJ、TSimTech 乃至 Airalo 等多供应商的 eSIM 套餐，覆盖 200+ 国家，价格常低于品牌自营。付款与售后经 MobiMatter 而非底层品牌。

network.en: Depends on the underlying supplier (e.g. IIJ in Japan)
network.zh: 取决于底层供应商（如日本 IIJ）

details.en:
MobiMatter is a marketplace rather than a carrier: one cart resells eSIM plans from multiple suppliers (Sparks, NextLink, IIJ, TSimTech, even Airalo packs) across 200+ countries, frequently below brand-direct prices - its homepage showed Japan 20GB (supplier IIJ) $13.99, Thailand 50GB $9.99 and Turkey 12GB $8.99 (live offers rendered 2026-11-10).

Value and risk sit together: cross-brand comparison is efficient and every plan names its underlying supplier, but payment and support run through MobiMatter rather than the network brand, activation/refund terms differ from buying direct, and the offer list moves fast - hot deals can disappear any time.

Who it fits: price hunters with basic supplier literacy who enjoy comparing across brands.

Notes: the marketplace states final prices bind at checkout; before stocking up on promo packs, confirm validity and the activation window so nothing expires unused.
details.zh:
MobiMatter 是市场聚合商而非运营商：一个购物车里转售多家供应商（Sparks、NextLink、IIJ、TSimTech 乃至 Airalo 包）的 eSIM 套餐，覆盖 200+ 国家，常低于品牌直售价——比如其首页日本 20GB（IIJ 供应商）$13.99、泰国 50GB $9.99、土耳其 12GB $8.99（2026-11-10 渲染首页实时报价）。

价值与风险并存：比价效率高、每单明示底层供应商；但付款与售后全部经 MobiMatter 中转，激活与退款条款与品牌直购不同，报价变动频繁，热促销档可能随时下架。

适合人群：愿意花时间跨品牌比价、对供应商品牌有基本判断力的用户。

注意：市场页明示「最终价格以结算为准」；囤促销包前先确认有效期与激活窗口，避免过期作废。
